verdict.rationale: Netlify documents a REST API for managing sites, deploys, DNS, etc. explicitly for 'automating workflows and integrating into your systems,' plus an official CLI wrapping it, and even an llms.txt for AI-native consumption. No formal OpenAPI spec was found at expected locations, slightly weakening machine-readability claims. missing for 10: discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec, independent developer corroboration of API robustness.
